title: tradefloor: a deterministic market simulator with a limit order book
description:
tradefloor is a deterministic market simulator with a real limit order book: a Rust core with a Python API. The same seed produces the same market on every platform, every price move carries a labelled factor decomposition, and orders match against depth so trading moves the price.

The model is specified in docs/MODEL.md, and the realism statistics it is checked against are defined in docs/STATISTICS.md. Results depend on the model preset: cite the preset name (for example pt-v19) with the version.
